title: AI Promo Video Maker for New Products | AIVideosUGC
description: Turn one product photo into a launch video. Pick a tall 9:16 or a square 1:1, at 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Add the real date and offer after download.
h1: AI Promo Video Maker for the Day You Release
lead: Pick a reveal scene and add one photo of the finished item, so the video is ready when your date is real. A script (the words), a voice, or a generated person (an AI actor) can go in the same file.
steps_h2: How to Make a Product Launch Video in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: A launch video starts with one photo of the finished item, a short reveal line, and a file you can post.

steps.d: Use one clear photo of the finished item you plan to release. Keep the whole product inside the frame.
Name a reveal, an unboxing, or a short demo. Then pick tall 9:16 or square 1:1, and 6 to 30 seconds.
Download the file and add the release date and offer in your own editor. Do not promise a date you have not set.

faq.q: What is a product launch video?
faq.a: It is a new product promo video for the day you release a finished item. Add a script, a voice, captions, and an AI actor if you want a presenter.

faq.q: How do I make the launch clip?
faq.a: Upload a photo of the finished item, name the reveal, and pick a size and a length. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.

faq.q: Why start from a photo instead of a launch shoot?
faq.a: You can make the reveal before release day without booking a creator. Check that the item on screen matches the finished product.
Shops and agencies announcing a finished item on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube. You can make a first file without video editing experience.

faq.q: Can I do this on the first try?
faq.a: Yes. Use one clear photo, describe a reveal or an unboxing, and download the file. Type the confirmed date yourself after download.
One clear photo of the finished item, with the whole product inside the photo. A product page link works when you want a first draft from the listing.

faq.q: How is a coming-soon clip different from release day?
faq.a: A coming-soon clip can say the item is on the way. On release day, add only a date and an offer you have confirmed. Do not let the written lines make up either one.

faq.q: Which size and length can I pick?
faq.a: Use a tall 9:16 or a square 1:1 for this launch clip. Other shapes are wide 16:9, slightly wide 4:3, and slightly tall 3:4. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.

A video costs 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. Starter is $24.50 a month with 200 credits. You see the cost before you start. If it fails, those credits come back. The download has no watermark.

faq.q: Can I publish it to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook?
faq.a: Yes. Publish to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook in one step, or download a file for YouTube. You can use it in ads. People on screen are generated presenters (AI actors), not real buyers.

faq.q: Can I announce several items at once?
faq.a: Yes. Run the same reveal on many photos at once, or start them from your own software (the API). Each one shows its credit cost first.
